text:
A sample of a radioactive isotope emits particles at a rate of 240 per minute.
After 48 hours the rate of emission has decreased to 15 per minute.
What is the half-life of the radioactive material?
A
4.0 hours
B
8.0 hours
C
12 hours
D
16 hours
subject: Physics
